title: Russia–Ukraine Invasion Shock (Feb–Mar 2022)
description: War in Europe drove an energy-price spike: energy and defence rallied, while chips, China and growth equities fell. Shocks are real total returns (Yahoo Finance adjusted close) from 2022-02-16 to 2022-03-08.
source_name: Yahoo Finance (adjusted close); events cited in references
transmission: 2022-02-24: Russia launches a full-scale invasion of Ukraine [1]
